```csharp
using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.ChatCompletion;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.AzureAIInference.Core;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

public class AzureAIInferenceServiceCollectionExtensionsTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void AddAzureAIInferenceChatCompletion_UsesProvidedChatClient()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var chatClientMock = new Mock<ChatCompletionsClient>(MockBehavior.Strict, new Uri("http://localhost"), null, null);
        var serviceProviderMock = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
        var loggerFactoryMock = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();

        // Setup service provider to return null for GetRequiredService to ensure provided chatClient is used
        serviceProviderMock.Setup(sp => sp.GetRequiredService(typeof(ChatCompletionsClient))).Throws(new Exception("Should not be called"));
        serviceProviderMock.Setup(sp => sp.GetService(typeof(ILoggerFactory))).Returns(loggerFactoryMock.Object);

        // Register a factory that uses the service provider mock
        services.AddSingleton(serviceProviderMock.Object);
        services.AddAzureAIInferenceChatCompletion("modelId", chatClientMock.Object);

        var provider = services.BuildServiceProvider();

        // Act
        var chatCompletionService = provider.GetRequiredService<IChatCompletionService>();

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(chatCompletionService);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddAzureAIInferenceChatCompletion_UsesServiceProviderChatClientWhenNull()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var chatClientMock = new Mock<ChatCompletionsClient>(MockBehavior.Strict, new Uri("http://localhost"), null, null);
        var loggerFactoryMock = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();

        // Setup service provider to return chatClientMock when GetRequiredService is called
        services.AddSingleton<ChatCompletionsClient>(chatClientMock.Object);
        services.AddSingleton<ILoggerFactory>(loggerFactoryMock.Object);

        services.AddAzureAIInferenceChatCompletion("modelId", chatClient: null);

        var provider = services.BuildServiceProvider();

        // Act
        var chatCompletionService = provider.GetRequiredService<IChatCompletionService>();

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(chatCompletionService);
    }
}
```

I see the problem is that Moq is trying to create a proxy for ChatCompletionsClient, which has ambiguous constructors, causing the proxy creation to fail. Since ChatCompletionsClient is a sealed or complex class from an external library, mocking it directly is problematic.

I will refactor the production code to allow injecting a factory or a delegate for creating the ChatCompletionsClient, or at least make the method virtual so I can subclass it in the test to override the behavior.

Since the method is an extension method, I cannot make it virtual, but I can apply the `parameterize_dependency` refactor to the AddAzureAIInferenceChatCompletion method that takes ChatCompletionsClient? to add an overload that takes a factory or service provider delegate for the ChatCompletionsClient, so I can pass a fake in the test.
